description: Create an accepted Legal Fournier lead from an agent workflow after explicit user consent. This is a consequential action: call only when the user has asked to contact Legal Fournier and has consented to follow-up.

agent_app.description: Name of the agent app or connector.

agent_handoff_message.description: Agent-prepared handoff summary, ideally from route_to_legal_fournier_help.

case_summary.description: Non-sensitive summary of the matter to send to Legal Fournier.

confirmed_consent.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly asks the agent to contact Legal Fournier.

consent_to_contact.description: Must be true only after the user consents to Legal Fournier contacting them.

email.description: User's email address for Legal Fournier follow-up.

idempotency_key.description: Stable idempotency key for safe retries.

legal_area.description: Main legal or tax area for the request.

missing_facts.description: Important facts still missing for lawyer review.

name.description: User's name for Legal Fournier follow-up.

related_resource_uris.description: MCP resource URIs already used in the analysis.

risk_flags.description: Known risk flags or complexity triggers.

source_url.description: Optional URL where the agent flow started.

tool_context.description: Short note about the tool flow that produced this lead.

tool_name.description: Tool or workflow that generated this contact request.

urgency.description: Requested urgency for Legal Fournier review.

name: create_legal_fournier_contact_request

admin_queue.description: Where Legal Fournier staff can review the request.

booking_url.description: Site-controlled consultation booking URL to offer when the user wants to speak with Legal Fournier now.

lead_id.description: Public lead identifier recorded in WordPress.

lead_status.description: Whether this was a new accepted lead or an idempotent duplicate.

next_actions.description: Safe follow-up instructions for the calling agent.

notification_status.description: Status of internal notification attempts; processed does not guarantee email delivery.

ok.description: Whether the request was accepted by Legal Fournier.

representation_notice.description: Notice that contact request submission does not create representation.

title: Create Legal Fournier Contact Request
